text:
Sophia: hey team, just FYI — someone just dropped an unlabelled envelope at the desk for 'marketing'. can someone check if it's for our meeting at 2? :eyes:
Front Desk: Front Desk: it's here. No name on it, says 'for marketing review'. There's also a visitor waiting outside who says they're with 'BrightSide' and forgot their badge.
Sophia: Sophia: That visitor must be for my 2pm review. I texted them to hang on. I'll come down in 3.
Tariq: Tariq: can front desk run the badge printer? Last time it printed blurred names.
Front Desk: Front Desk: printer is on a fussy streak, jammed this morning but cleared. If badge fails, kiosk has quick sign-in: `guest add BRIGHTSIDE_VISITOR by Sophia` then temp lanyard.
BadgeBot: BadgeBot: awaiting manual sign-in at kiosk
DeliveryBot: DeliveryBot: package logged: envelope id #E-7832 placed on parcel shelf — recipient unknown
Sophia: Sophia: grabbing the visitor now. also can someone claim the window seat? Need quiet for the call.
People Ops: People Ops: window couch is free until 14:10, but the lounge is booked 14:15-14:45 for user research. If you need the quietest spot, small conf room B is open.
Tariq: Tariq: I'll take conf B at 14:00. @Sophia take the couch.
Front Desk: Front Desk: Visitor signed in via kiosk: BRIGHTSIDE_VISITOR by Sophia 9 min expiration temp #7792. Envelope moved to secure shelf and tagged with E-7832.
Sophia: Sophia: thanks! met with Kate from BrightSide — she left a business card in the envelope, labelled 'KM'. Meeting over, left laptop at hotdesk-7 while I grab coffee.
Tariq: Tariq: also please label personal items folks — we had someone take an unlabelled umbrella by mistake yesterday.
People Ops: People Ops: noted. We're ordering a cheap label printer for the hotdesk area. Also reminder: if you borrow a temp lanyard, return it to Front Desk when you sign out.
BadgeBot: BadgeBot: guest signed-out: BRIGHTSIDE_VISITOR at 15:45
Front Desk: Front Desk: envelope E-7832 will be delivered to Marketing mailbox A12 at end of day. Thanks all.
